notes.title: Railink Playtest has started!
notes.content:
Thanks to all who already signed up for the Playtest! A first batch of players have been given access to the game.

For those in the Playtest, we'd appreciate any feedback, either via the in-game survey or just send an email to [url=mailto:info@polygonmatter.com]info@polygonmatter.com[/url]. Happy testing!

If you didn't make it, don't worry just yet! We have started small and would like to add more soon depending on how things go.

Other ways to keep updated:

[url=https://youtube.com/@polygonmatter]https://youtube.com/@polygonmatter[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/@polygonmatter]https://twitter.com/@polygonmatter[/url]
